Review technical drawings, specifications, and installation requirements to ensure proper execution and resolve technical conflicts. Provide technical support and troubleshooting for mechanical, electrical, and electromechanical systems, including motors, control panels, PLCs, sensors, and safety devices. Develop and implement preventive and corrective maintenance plans, managing service requests, warranty cases, and after-sales technical support. Manage installation tools, equipment, spare parts, and company vehicles, ensuring proper utilization and maintenance. Ensure compliance with technical specifications, quality standards, installation procedures, and occupational health and safety requirements. Develop installation and maintenance manuals, technical procedures, checklists, and training programs. Evaluate team performance, identify training needs, and develop technicians’ technical and professional competencies. Monitor departmental KPIs, productivity, project progress, operational costs, customer satisfaction, and maintenance performance. Analyze recurring technical issues, implement corrective actions, and continuously improve installation methods and product reliability. Good understanding of PLCs, electronic control systems, sensors, and motorization solutions. Experience in site surveys, technical measurements, reviewing engineering drawings, and managing installation projects. Previous experience in industrial doors, rolling shutters, sectional doors, loading docks, automatic gates, elevators, or similar industrial equipment is highly preferred. Strong leadership, team management, planning, and problem-solving skills. Excellent coordination and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and work under pressure. Good command of English and proficiency in Microsoft Office. Willingness to travel to project sites across Egypt when required. Valid driving license is an advantage.
